name: shaka-blockly
title: Google Shaka Player + Blockly, ADVANCED
description: Two flagship real-world Closure Compiler `ADVANCED` codebases compiled together (847 files, 8.6 MB, 93.9% typed): Google Shaka Player 5.3.1 (`lib/`, `ui/`, `externs/`, `third_party/`, `dist/locales.js`, 522 files) and Google Blockly 8.0.5 (`core/`, `blocks/`, `generators/`, 324 files, the last pure-Closure release before TypeScript migration) on top of `closure/goog/base.js`, with `--compilation_level=ADVANCED`, `--language_out=ECMASCRIPT5`, `--jscomp_warning=checkTypes`, `--generate_exports`, and source map output.
mode: ADVANCED, `--language_out=ECMASCRIPT5`, type checking on (`--jscomp_warning=checkTypes`), `--generate_exports`, source map
